title: 第530章 果断第529章 祸事了
lines: “出来。”
小心甩去竹剑上的道则，回头看向一片空白处。
空间一阵抖动，李寻身披太极图道袍缓缓现身，双腿有些控制不住的微微打摆子。
他神色尴尬的作揖道：“见过青木天尊，福生无量天尊，贫道刚才什么也没看见。”
小心脚踏虚空提剑漫步走向他，边道：“小道士，你看见我的秘密了，你说我该如何收拾你？”
“这这这……”李寻更慌了，马上头脑风暴解释道：“这个这个，贫道确实看见了，方才妄语只是以为天尊喜欢这个答案……”
说到这，他突然浑身放松作揖道：“贫道还是不善言辞，请问天尊如何才能放过贫道。
修行不易，贫道心中还有远大理想没实现。”
小心用剑在他脖子上比划道：“小道士，我问你，之前为什么要帮我掩盖天机？”
“你知道？”李寻顿时松了口气，好歹是看见自己在帮她，这样一来总能给条活路吧。
他一脸悲悯道：“贫道是不忍天下苍生被波及，因此才帮天尊掩盖一番。”
“可惜。”轻叹一声，小心放下竹剑，道：“可惜你的一番心思都白费了，都怪这老头多管闲事来这里探查。”
老祖既然肯给他机缘，自然是认可他的心性。
再加上他之前还帮忙主动掩盖天机的份上，小心决定留他一命。
最主要的还是他太弱鸡了，即便他心怀不轨也扛不住小心一剑。
李寻叹息一声，一时之间也不知该如何是好，便问道：“他们死了，很快背后势力便会有所反应，天尊你打算怎么办？”
小心微微抬起竹剑，十五度朝下，道：“唯有一战了，还能怎么办。”
李寻惊道：“怎么可能，无极界的事情败露，届时所有界主境都会蜂拥而至，凭你一人之力又怎么可能是他们对手。”
小心答非所问，突然抬手一掌将他给拍飞，“你该走了。”
李寻的身影消失，远方有一道剑光朝着小心劈过来，同时还有一道怒吼声：“混账！你竟敢杀轩辕氏！”
轩辕氏活着的老家伙来了，与此同时还有另一道身影出现，那是无陨的师祖。
小心挥剑驱散剑光，不慌不忙朝着九重天疾驰而去。
那二人对视一眼，没有丝毫耽搁便追了上去。
二人即将穿过一层薄膜，齐齐进入九重天中。
“不好！”
其中一人瞬间察觉出异常，此地时间流速极端异常。
没等他细想，小心已经提剑而来。
轩辕氏老古董主动迎了上去，二人很快便战成一团。
content_en:
"Come out."
Carefully shake off the Dao on the bamboo sword and look back at a blank space.
The space trembled for a while, and Li Xun slowly appeared wearing a Tai Chi Taoist robe, his legs swaying slightly uncontrollably.
He bowed in embarrassment and said: "I have seen the Qingmu Tianzun and the Blessings Boundless Tianzun, but I didn't see anything just now."
Carefully walking towards him with his sword in hand, he said, "Little Taoist priest, you have seen my secret. How do you think I should deal with you?"
"This, this, this..." Li Xun became even more panicked, and immediately brainstormed and explained: "This, this, this, Pindao did see it, and he just lied because he thought Tianzun liked this answer..."
Having said this, he suddenly relaxed and bowed: "Pindao is still not good at speaking. I would like to ask Tianzun how to let Pindao go.
Cultivation is not easy, and poor Taoists still have lofty ideals that have not yet been realized. "
Xin Xing made signs on his neck with his sword: "Little Taoist priest, let me ask you, why did you help me cover up the secret before?"
"You know?" Li Xun breathed a sigh of relief. At least he saw that he was helping her. This would give him a way to survive.
He said with a look of pity: "I couldn't bear to have the world affected, so I helped Tianzun cover it up."
"It's a pity." He sighed softly, carefully put down his bamboo sword, and said, "It's a pity that all your efforts were in vain. It's all because of this old man's meddling in coming here to investigate."
Since the ancestor was willing to give him a chance, he naturally recognized his character.
In addition, since he had previously helped to cover up the secret, Chunzhong decided to spare his life.
The most important thing is that he is too weak. Even if he has evil intentions, he cannot withstand a careful sword.
Li Xun sighed, not knowing what to do for a moment, so he asked: "They are dead, and the forces behind them will react soon. Tianzun, what are you going to do?"
Xin Xin raised the bamboo sword slightly, pointed it downwards at fifteen degrees, and said: "We only have one battle, what else can we do?"
Li Xun was shocked and said: "How is it possible? What happened in the Wuji Realm is exposed, and then all the Realm Lords will swarm in. How can you be their opponent with your own strength?"
Carefully answering the question, she suddenly raised her hand and slapped him away, "It's time for you to go."
Li Xun's figure disappeared, and a sword light struck Xiao Xin from the distance. At the same time, there was a roar: "You bastard! How dare you kill the Xuanyuan family!"
The living old guy of the Xuanyuan family came, and at the same time another figure appeared, that was Wu Yuan's master.
He carefully swung his sword to disperse the sword light and galloped towards the Nine Heavens without any hesitation.
The two men looked at each other and chased after them without any delay.
The two of them are about to pass through a thin film and enter the Nine Heavens together.
"Not good!"
One of them instantly noticed an abnormality, and the flow of time here was extremely abnormal.
Before he could think about it carefully, Xiao was already coming with his sword.
Xuanyuan's old antique took the initiative to greet him, and the two soon fought together.
